metadata.scope: Exactly125 unique findings UAT001–125; reopened068 counted once.126–136 are controller-owned and referenced only where they qualify earlier acceptance.
metadata.method: Read-only review of tracker, official child task records, retained implementation/independent/native reports and selected exact captures. No browser, runtime, inference, source/task edit or test execution. Existing test counts are report evidence, not fresh reruns. Path existence and SHA256 attest this audit input snapshot; not a fresh full evidence-manifest audit.

dispositions.verified: Original finding has post-repair native evidence within the stated limits; this is not release sign-off or a fresh full-matrix claim.
dispositions.implemented-awaiting-acceptance: Implementation/regressions exist but the exact original native scenario is missing, partial, superseded or must be rerun after a later repair.
dispositions.blocked: Implemented with an explicit external/tool limitation preventing required native acceptance.

conservative_rules: Task status/checked acceptance criteria are context only, never sufficient closure evidence.
Later unrelated successful workflows do not substitute for the failing producer, negative branch or account boundary.
Historical failed checks and misleading final/terminal filenames remain qualified.
UAT068 remains awaiting current native acceptance after98329099db.
UAT114 genuine hidden-tab behavior and UAT118 canonical stored-image recovery remain blockers.
UAT095 originated as a synthetic actual-transport finding; this audit does not invent a native disclosure.
